posts.title: Show, and new tape with Death Kneel
posts.description: Hi! I'm playing a show in Toronto tomorrow with Auto Feeder, Death Kneel, Richard (Montreal), Ciro Vitiello (Italy), and Moss Harvest (Halifax). Death Kneel and I have made a short split tape for the occasion. You can listen to the whole thing here , and it'll be available on bandcamp as well. Information and tickets for the show are available here , and you can of course pay at the door as well.

posts.title: Smeared Moon
posts.description: Hi, I have a new tape today called Smeared Moon. You can listen to it on bandcamp here . I've made copies to have for sale at my upcoming shows with Lucas Abela and Death Kneel, as well as for Initial Shock in Montreal. After that, if you'd like a copy please email beetraverse@proton.me.
